headline: Key Handling Code Needs Stabilization
diagnosis: The recurring theme in the commit messages indicates ongoing issues with key normalization and display consistency. Frequent mentions of 'normalize keys', 'centralize key display', and 'fix snapshots' suggest that the current implementation is not meeting the expected behavior, leading to repeated revisions.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the key normalization logic to identify inconsistencies and edge cases that may be causing issues.
Establish a set of comprehensive unit tests focusing on key handling functionalities, especially around normalization and display.
Refactor the key handling code to simplify the logic and improve clarity, ensuring that all key-related functions are consistently applied across the codebase.
Engage with the authors of recent commits to gather insights on specific pain points and address any unresolved issues collaboratively.
owner_hint: Ownership should be shared among the last six commit authors.
